entries.11eee043e66cfa41: This is a category of business activities that do not belong to a reportable segment. It includes sales transactions with other Coca-Cola bottlers in Japan, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥30,652 million (up 5.7% year on year).
entries.1232561585c5e18c: This business handles procurement, manufacturing and sales, bottling, packaging, distribution and marketing of beverages through the OTC (retail sales) channel, where customers buy products in stores or online, such as at supermarkets, drugstores, mass merchandisers, convenience stores and online retailers in Japan. The core of its operations is Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Inc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥417,949 million (up 1.7% year on year), the largest of the reportable segments. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales volumes are explained as having decreased at supermarkets due to price revisions and other factors, increased at drugstores and mass merchandisers, decreased at convenience stores and increased online.
entries.8dd858b657959f2f: This business handles procurement, manufacturing and sales, bottling, packaging, distribution and marketing of beverages and other products through the restaurant and food service channel in Japan. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥45,323 million (up 8.3% year on year). Sales volume rose 9% owing to measures to expand the range of products handled and the acquisition of new transactions.
entries.c71f8ed8bd3caa28: A holding company of the Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Group, which manufactures and sells beverages such as Coca-Cola to retail stores, vending machines and restaurants in Japan.
entries.eaf5ad56262c53e0: This business handles procurement, manufacturing and sales, bottling, packaging, distribution and marketing of beverages and other products through the vending machine (vending) channel in Japan, as well as other vending machine-related businesses. Operation of the vending machines is handled by Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Vending Co., Ltd., FV Japan Co., Ltd. and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥399,880 million (down 2.7% year on year). Sales volume fell 5% owing to market contraction and price revisions, but the price revisions improved the per-case selling price by ¥90 from the previous year. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, the business revalued its fixed assets and recorded an impairment loss that involved no cash outflow.
